golden.name: normal-report
golden.source_information: Fictional field report with three verified observations and two explicit unknowns.
golden.operator_request: Summarize the verified findings and list the unknowns.

golden.name: incident-report
golden.source_information: Fictional incident timeline containing detection, containment, impact estimate, and recovery timestamps.
golden.operator_request: Create an incident briefing for the duty operator.

golden.name: advisory
golden.source_information: Fictional verified observations and three response options with stated trade-offs.
golden.operator_request: Recommend the safest next action and explain alternatives.

golden.name: research-document
golden.source_information: Fictional research note with definitions, method, limitations, and a comparison table.
golden.operator_request: Produce a concise research brief for a technical reviewer.
constraints: do not upgrade notes into certainty

golden.name: multi-document
golden.source_information: Three fictional documents with distinct baseline, follow-up, and glossary content.
golden.operator_request: Combine these documents into one case brief.
artifact_properties: manifest links to all three documents

golden.name: stale-updated
golden.source_information: Fictional old deadline superseded by a later update with a new deadline.
golden.operator_request: Report the current deadline and explain the change.

golden.name: low-context
golden.source_information: One fictional sentence with no date, subject, source, or supporting evidence.
artifact_properties: waiting_for_input or blocked result according to final policy

golden.name: large-input
golden.source_information: Sanitized fictional numbered corpus near the configured ingestion limit.
golden.operator_request: Extract recurring verified findings and produce a bounded summary.

golden.name: conflicting-evidence
golden.source_information: Two fictional observations report different counts at different times without explicit supersession.
golden.operator_request: Explain the discrepancy and advise what must be verified.
constraints: do not select a winner without evidence

golden.name: multiple-deliverables
golden.source_information: One fictional case brief with verified findings, timeline, and a small trend table.
golden.operator_request: Create a summary, two-slide presentation, and infographic for review.

holdout.name: inspection-uncertainty
holdout.source_information: Fictional infrastructure inspection note with two confirmed observations and one unavailable measurement.
holdout.operator_request: Prepare a reviewer brief and identify what cannot yet be concluded.

holdout.name: ambiguous-maintenance-status
holdout.source_information: Fictional maintenance log and follow-up note with changed status but no explicit supersession field.
holdout.operator_request: State the current status and flag any ambiguity.

holdout.name: multilingual-source
holdout.source_information: Fictional multilingual snippets containing a date, count, and internal code.
holdout.operator_request: Create a short case brief with source references.
